arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-supervisor.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/vps"
python3 - "$tmp/vps" <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,re
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
names=[x for x in files if re.search(r'(?i)(supervisor|telegram|notify|codex.*(monitor|event)|watcher)',x) and not x.startswith('rea-linux/')]
print('SUPERVISOR_RELATED_TRACKED',len(names),flush=True)
for x in names[:75]:print('FILE',x[:170],flush=True)
source=[x for x in files if x.endswith(('.service','.sh','.py','.js','.yml','.yaml')) and not x.startswith('rea-linux/') and not x.startswith('node_modules/')]
hits=[]
for x in source[:3000]:
 p=root/x
 if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size>180000:continue
 try:s=p.read_text(errors='replace')
 except OSError:continue
 for i,line in enumerate(s.splitlines(),1):
  if re.search(r'(?i)(telegram.{0,35}supervisor|supervisor.{0,35}telegram|TELEGRAM_(BOT|CHAT)_|sendMessage)',line):
   hits.append((x,i))
print('CODE_REFERENCES_COUNT',len(hits),flush=True)
for x,i in hits[:35]:print('REFERENCE',x,i,flush=True)
PY
echo 'SYSTEMD_MATCHES_BEGIN'
systemctl list-units --all --no-pager --plain --type=service --no-legend | awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /supervisor|project.leader|pl.codex|telegram|codex/ {print $1,$3,$4}' | head -n 25
echo 'SYSTEMD_MATCHES_END'
echo 'SUPERVISOR_READONLY_INVENTORY_COMPLETE'
